tools.name: audit_secheaders
tools.description: Full security headers + TLS audit of a website URL. Fetches the target server-side, probes TLS on port 443, checks whether the plain-HTTP variant redirects to HTTPS, and runs 11 weighted checks: HTTPS redirect enforcement, TLS modernity (negotiated version plus TLS 1.0/1.1 acceptance), certificate v

tools.name: audit_secheaders_lite
tools.description: FREE lite security headers + TLS audit of a website URL. Runs the same 11 checks as audit_secheaders but returns top-line results only: 0-100 score, A-F grade, exposure-risk level, check counts, and the titles of the top gaps — detail is capped (no per-check evidence, no site block, no detailed fixe

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "audit_secheaders" references sensitive artifacts (cookie). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
